Messages.Author: Damnans
Messages.Body:
1.- Methuselah A bleeds Methuselah B for 1 pool, and
Methuselah C plays Major Boon. Can A play superior
Spying Mission?.

2.- Etrius bleeds for 5 pool to his prey, and his prey plays
Archon Investigation. Can Etrius' controller have one of
his other minions play Mask of 1000 Faces to avoid Etrius'
destruction?.

3.- What happens when a Methuselah plays Memories of
Mortality on a vampire in torpor?. Could that vampire burn
this card during his controller's influence phase?.

Thanks in advance.
Greetings,
Damnans

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Damnans wrote:
>
> 1.- Methuselah A bleeds Methuselah B for 1 pool, and
> Methuselah C plays Major Boon. Can A play superior
> Spying Mission?.

Yes. The Boon then fizzles.

> 2.- Etrius bleeds for 5 pool to his prey, and his prey plays
> Archon Investigation. Can Etrius' controller have one of
> his other minions play Mask of 1000 Faces to avoid Etrius'
> destruction?.

No. Sudden Reversal is the only way to "interrupt" the
master card's effect.

> 3.- What happens when a Methuselah plays Memories of
> Mortality on a vampire in torpor?. Could that vampire burn
> this card during his controller's influence phase?.

Yes.
